title: UNITED COMMUNITY BANKS INC 8-K Filing — 2026-04-21
summary: United Community Banks, Inc. (UCB) and Peach State Bancshares, Inc. have entered into a Merger Agreement dated April 21, 2026, pursuant to which Peach State will merge with and into United, with United surviving. Following the merger of the holding companies, Peach State Bank & Trust will merge into United Community Bank.
key_points: United Community Banks, Inc. (NYSE: UCB) and Peach State Bancshares, Inc. announced entry into a Merger Agreement on April 21, 2026.
Peach State will merge into United, with United surviving as the corporation.
The wholly-owned bank subsidiary Peach State Bank & Trust will merge into United Community Bank, with United Community Bank surviving.
The filing includes a Joint Press Release (Exhibit 99.1) and an Investor Presentation (Exhibit 99.2) as attachments.
Forward-looking statements in the filing cite risks including failure to realize cost savings, regulatory approval requirements, and integration challenges.
Common stock of United Community Banks trades on the New York Stock Exchange under symbol UCB.
